items.title: Coherence of the higher direct images of a coherent module along a proper morphism of algebraic spaces

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the higher direct images of a coherent module under a proper morphism of algebraic spaces to a locally Noetherian target are coherent (statement lines 3834-3841). The proof first reduces to a Noetherian affine base by etale locality, then invokes a three-condition criterion for the class of coherent modules, verifying two-out-of-three and direct-sum stability, and finally reduces condition (3) to a sheaf on a closed reduced irreducible subspace that is dominated by a proper cover mapping into projective space, where twisting and a support computation finish the argument. The reduction to the criterion and the support verification are the substance, so the claim is H2.
